title: West Africa Daily Intelligence Brief
executive_summary: Today's West Africa briefing is shaped primarily by security, politics and economy. Significant developments are concentrated in Ghana, Niger, Burkina Faso. Security pressures remain an important source of political and humanitarian risk; while economic policy and market conditions continue to influence investor confidence and household welfare.

learning.title: Why currency instability matters
learning.description: Sharp currency movements can increase import costs, raise inflation and make foreign-currency debt harder to service. They can therefore affect public finances, business confidence and political stability.

methodology: Stories are collected from public Google News RSS searches, classified using keyword rules, filtered for near-duplicates and ranked using source quality, recency and political-risk relevance.
